title: Loop 005 Shared Minimum-Cut Screen v001
question: Does current direct human causal evidence identify a shared anatomical bottleneck that is specifically necessary for felt affect across otherwise distinct routes?

admission_criteria.spared_by_counterexamples: Candidate must not already be absent/destroyed in a reliable case with preserved broad feeling.
admission_criteria.feeling_specific_necessity: Selective damage/perturbation must abolish or sharply eliminate felt affect, not merely emotion recognition, autonomic output, memory, arousal, access, or motor report.
admission_criteria.observability: Wakefulness and a viable first-person report/communication channel must remain sufficiently intact to assess feeling.
admission_criteria.causal_directness: Evidence must be lesion, blockade, stimulation, or similarly direct causal perturbation rather than correlation alone.
admission_criteria.replication: Prefer replicated/multi-patient evidence; single cases can refute universal necessity but cannot alone establish a universal bottleneck.

lesion_complement_constraints.preserved_outcome: broad body and emotional feelings plus sentience
lesion_complement_constraints.consequence: Any listed structure, and the listed damaged bundle as a whole, cannot be a universally necessary anatomical minimum cut for broad feeling in the simple sense.

candidates.rationale: Focal lesions in this region are associated with coma and it is connected to cortical consciousness-related regions.
candidates.source: Fischer et al. 2016, Neurology, DOI 10.1212/WNL.0000000000003404, PMID 27815400
candidates.note: Supports a wakefulness/consciousness-maintenance role, not a feeling-specific minimum cut.

candidates.rationale: Functionally connected to coma-associated pontine region in Fischer et al.
candidates.source: Fischer et al. 2016 plus Damasio et al. 2013
candidates.note: Patient B had complete bilateral insula plus affective ACC destruction with broad feelings intact.

candidates.rationale: Spared in the major bilateral-insula lesion case and repeatedly implicated in bodily/emotional representation.
candidates.source: Damasio et al. 2013; Adolphs et al. 2000 DOI 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.20-07-02683.2000
candidates.note: Lesion evidence strongly concerns recognition/simulation of others' emotions, not abolition of own felt affect.

candidates.rationale: Direct stimulation can evoke profound negative affect.
candidates.note: Stimulation rapidly recruits multiple limbic/cortical structures.

candidates.rationale: Human stimulation can evoke panic-like anxiety and autonomic arousal.
candidates.note: Causal participation is plausible; universal bottleneck status is not established.

candidates.rationale: HOTEC/GNWT-style candidates place conscious content in higher-order/global cortical organization.
candidates.source: LeDoux & Brown 2017 and GNWT literature; assessed previously in theory-discrimination audits
candidates.note: A decisive knockout also undermines the direct report/access channel, so current evidence cannot establish feeling-specific necessity.

candidates.rationale: A shared causal state may be distributed across varying anatomical implementations rather than localized to one node.
candidates.source: Hypothesis class motivated by atlas v001, not an established result
candidates.note: Retained as an open class, not counted as an identified cut.

decision_rule: IDENTIFIED_SHARED_MINIMUM_CUT only if at least one candidate satisfies all four core gates: spared_by_counterexamples=true, feeling_specific_necessity=true, observability_after_decisive_loss=true, and direct_causal_evidence=true. Otherwise NO_SHARED_MINIMUM_CUT_IDENTIFIED.
consequence: Failure means current human causal evidence supports route multiplicity but does not yet distinguish true downstream degeneracy from convergence onto an unidentified distributed or inaccessible bottleneck.
